title: Defcon 5
overview:
2205 Anno Domini

In the year of grace 2205, humanity mines the asteroids that orbit distant planets. The Tyron Corporation holds the monopoly on the defense of its bases.

You are alone on one of these bases, lost at the far reaches of space. The Tyron Corporation has put you in charge of locking down the base... when suddenly, after 200 years of peace, the aliens attack.

It is the start of a real race against the clock. You will have to repel the aliens' assault waves, place the automatic defenses strategically, and save the base. The stakes are high: stay alive and reveal to humanity the greatest deception in its history.
